# garage_cluster_status (Data Source)

Read the current Garage cluster status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_cluster_status" "current" {}

output "garage_version" {
  value = data.garage_cluster_status.current.garage_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `layout_version` (Number) Current layout version.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Cluster nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `addr` (String) Socket address.
- `draining` (Boolean) Whether the node is draining.
- `garage_version` (String) Garage version.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname.
- `id` (String) Node ID.
- `is_up` (Boolean) Whether the node is connected.
